[Summon Condition: You have at least 1 Green Spirit.]
Flash [High Speed]
You may summon this Ultimate card from your Hand by paying its summon cost and placing its required Cores using only Cores from your Reserve.
LV4 [Ultimate Trigger] When This Ultimate Battles
If the Ultimate Trigger hits, when only an opposing Spirit is destroyed by BP comparison, refresh this Ultimate.
(Ultimate Trigger: Discard the top card of the opposing deck. If its cost is lower than this Ultimate's cost, it hits.)
